title: Marvel's 'VisionQuest' Weighs In on a Big Fan Debate
summary:
Marvel's newest Disney+ show, 'VisionQuest,' is taking a side in an argument fans have had since 2021. This story has spoilers for Episode 3.

The show follows Vision, an android hero played by Paul Bettany, and his son Tommy. It continues the story from 'WandaVision' and 'Agatha All Along.'

In 'WandaVision,' Wanda was very sad after losing Vision. She used magic to create a pretend TV-sitcom world in a town called Westview, and she controlled the people living there. Some fans thought she was becoming a villain. Others thought she was a hero overwhelmed by sadness.

In Episode 3, called 'Reboot,' Vision explains to Tommy where he came from. He says Wanda's actions were morally wrong. This Vision, called White Vision, was rebuilt from the first Vision's parts.

The writer of the original article thinks the show admits Wanda hurt people but still treats Tommy's creation as good. New episodes stream every Tuesday.
why_it_matters: It helps kids think about how a character can do something wrong even when they feel very sad.
